citation: Feng et al. (2023). TrafficGen: Learning to Generate Diverse and Realistic Traffic Scenarios. ICRA, 3567-3575. https://arxiv.org/abs/2210.06609
description: TrafficGen is Feng, Li, Peng, Tan and Zhou's learned model for generating road-traffic scenarios. The repository provides vehicle-placement and trajectory-generation models, preprocessing instructions, sample tests and an interface that exports generated scenarios to MetaDrive. Inputs include road layouts, traffic observations and model settings; outputs are synthetic vehicle placements, trajectories and scenario pickle files. Spatial extent and time sampling follow the source scenes, with Waymo motion data documented for training. Source is free under Apache-2.0; external driving data require separate registration and terms. A limitation is that generated traffic reflects its training distribution and does not establish real-world safety. TrafficGen can prepare diverse road simulations and reinforcement-learning environments. SUMO (model-sumo) is related traffic simulation software. Public instructions describe training and inference, but no driving data, pretrained weights or simulation environment was downloaded.
name: TrafficGen traffic scenario generation
